description: FREE. Get the EXACT x402 payment requirements for one Settlement Army service, for the specific input you intend to buy. Returns the verbatim 402 challenge — use requirements.accepts[0] to construct and sign a payment with your OWN x402 client and wallet (e.g. x402-fetch createPaymentHeader). Never send keys anywhere; this server never holds funds and never signs.

input.description: the request body you intend to buy, e.g. {"mode":"prediction","query":"election"}

service_id.description: soldier id from army_list_services, e.g. sol-23-onchain-base

name: army_quote
